scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young boy wearing a gold circlet, cream tunic and blue mantle sits on a carved wooden throne, his sandaled feet on a cushioned stool. Warm sunlight falls across a stone terrace overlooking pale buildings and hills, with olive branches overhead and a flowering pot beside the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined portrait represents Josiah at the beginning of his reign, when he was eight. The large chair and footstool emphasize his youth; the Jerusalem vista connects him to the city where he ruled thirty-one years. The verse does not describe this courtyard, clothing, circlet or pose, and the picture does not depict the passage of those years.
